![更完善的積雪覆蓋](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6eb8f1959d329d4398c6e69976ab4d70b74e6c5d.png)

![Sodium](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ToBinio/dense-flowers/refs/heads/main/assets/Requires_Sodium_cosy.svg)
![Forge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/unsupported/forge_vector.svg)

這是一個 Fabric 模組，會在與數層積雪接觸的方塊下方顯示一層積雪。

本模組無需安裝於伺服器端，即可讓你享受遍地的積雪效果。

![模組預覽](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9f9c1df5ac9b710584572f281083dd13ab5d01e.gif)
